text: Hi, we are waiting for my citizen application answer since November, but my visa expires in less than one month (after the war extension). We have a big trip scheduled in August and are wondering what to do. Should we go to the Jerusalem branch and wait there early in the morning (7am ish) in line in the hope MH will receive us and help us, or there is some other procedure? We sent them an email a month ago, and they just told us there is nothing new and to wait
